<figure class="wp-block-image is-resized is-style-rounded"><img decoding="async" src="https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/cropped-cropped-olena-square-closer-300x300.jpg" alt="cropped-cropped-olena-square-closer-300x300" class="wp-image-91067" style="width:120px;height:120px"></figure>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">This is the best fish tacos recipe! Just read reviews for yourself.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">I think the best fish tacos should be crispy, battered and fried, just like you get at any surf and turf joint. Fish has to be spicy and flavorful enough to help the plain veggies a bit. Everything is tied together with creamy zesty and spicy sauce!</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">That’s these fish tacos! It’s a <a href="https://ifoodreal.com/healthy-30-minute-meals/">weeknight dinner</a> ready in 25 minutes from fridge to table, including making the fish taco sauce!</p>

<div id="AdThrive_Content_1_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-1 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div><h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-ingredients-you-will-need">Ingredients for Fish Tacos Recipe</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">As always, my recipe is simple. And I even give you options for flours to use.</p>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img decoding="async" width="1250" height="833" src="https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/fish-tacos.jpg" alt="White fish, taco seasoning, mayo, plain yogurt, lime, avocado, tomato, tortillas, cilantro, flour, red onion, cabbage." class="wp-image-111939" srcset="https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/fish-tacos.jpg 1250w, https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/fish-tacos-300x200.jpg 300w, https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/fish-tacos-1200x800.jpg 1200w, https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/fish-tacos-768x512.jpg 768w, https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/fish-tacos-150x100.jpg 150w" sizes="(max-width: 800px) 100vw, 800px"></figure>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Fish:</strong> Any firm white fish fillets that holds its shape. It does not have to be white fish but rather fish that doesn’t flake easily and fall apart. Cod, halibut, bass, haddock, rockfish, mahi mahi or snapper are great. Tilapia will not work. You can even use salmon or trout, if that’s what you have. </li>



<li><strong>Flour:</strong> Any flour works! <a href="https://ifoodreal.com/how-to-make-almond-flour/">Almond flour</a> or almond meal, all purpose flour or whole wheat flour, spelt flour, gluten free flour, or even breadcrumbs. Anything that will make fish crispy.</li>



<li><strong>Simple spices:</strong> I use <a href="https://ifoodreal.com/taco-seasoning-recipe/">homemade taco seasoning</a> and garlic powder.</li>



<li><strong>Yogurt and mayo:</strong> I call my fish taco sauce healthy because I use 75% plain <a href="https://ifoodreal.com/instant-pot-yogurt/">yogurt</a> and 25% mayonnaise unlike any restaurant’s 100% mayo white sauce.</li>



<li><strong>Oil:</strong> For frying I like to use high smoke point oil like avocado oil.</li>



<li><strong>Toppings:</strong> Red cabbage, tomato, avocado, fresh cilantro, and lime are our favorite fish taco toppings but you can use what you have on hand.</li>



<li><strong>Tortillas:</strong> You can use corn tortillas or flour tortillas for serving. We use corn tortillas because they are more authentic and nutritious. </li>



<li><strong>Cheese (optional):</strong> The best cheese for fish tacos is cotija cheese. It is Mexican cheese that is more mild and less salty than feta cheese and crumbles as you shred it. You can also use crumbled feta cheese.</li>
</ul>



<div id="AdThrive_Content_2_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-2 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div><h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-how-to-make-healthy-fish-tacos">How to Make Fish Tacos</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">There are 3 steps to making fish tacos: cook the fish, make the fish taco sauce and prepare the taco toppings. It doesn’t get easier than that.</p>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img decoding="async" width="800" height="530" src="https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/fish-tacos-recipe-2.jpg" alt="Cubed fish on a plate, seasoned flour in a bowl and fish taco sauce in a measuring cup." class="wp-image-48417" srcset="https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/fish-tacos-recipe-2.jpg 800w, https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/fish-tacos-recipe-2-300x199.jpg 300w, https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/fish-tacos-recipe-2-768x509.jpg 768w" sizes="(max-width: 800px) 100vw, 800px"></figure>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Prep fish and its dredging:</strong> Cut fish into 1-inch cubes and in a medium bowl whisk flour, taco seasoning, garlic powder, cornstarch, salt and pepper.</p>



<div id="AdThrive_Content_3_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-3 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div><figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="800" height="530" src="https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/fish-tacos-recipe-4.jpg" alt="Crispy fried fish on a plate." class="wp-image-48419" srcset="https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/fish-tacos-recipe-4.jpg 800w, https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/fish-tacos-recipe-4-300x199.jpg 300w, https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/fish-tacos-recipe-4-768x509.jpg 768w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 800px) 100vw, 800px"></figure>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>To cook fish:</strong> Dip fish pieces into flour mixture and pan fry for 2 minutes per side in preheated large ceramic non-stick skillet on medium high heat.</p>



<div id="AdThrive_Content_4_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-4 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div><h2 class="wp-block-heading">Make Best Fish Taco Sauce</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Make fish taco sauce</strong> while fish is cooking. In a medium bowl, whisk yogurt, mayo, fresh lime juice, taco seasoning, cayenne pepper and black pepper.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Adjust amount of cayenne pepper to your taste or add some sriracha if you like your fish tacos spicy. If the sauce is too thick, add 1 teaspoon of water at a time until desired consistency is reached. This could be the case if you used Greek yogurt.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">I also like to transfer fish taco sauce to a drizzling bottle.</p>



<div id="AdThrive_Content_5_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-5 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div><figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="800" height="530" src="https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/fish-tacos-recipe-5.jpg" alt="Fish taco sauce in a bottle. Chopped fish taco toppings in a dish and crispy fish on a plate." class="wp-image-48420" srcset="https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/fish-tacos-recipe-5.jpg 800w, https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/fish-tacos-recipe-5-300x199.jpg 300w, https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/fish-tacos-recipe-5-768x509.jpg 768w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 800px) 100vw, 800px"></figure>



<div id="AdThrive_Content_6_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-6 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div><h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-toppings-and-sauce">Fish Taco Toppings</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The finishing touch on these fish tacos are the toppings! Set up a taco bar and let each family member customize their taco how they like them for a peaceful and delicious <a href="https://ifoodreal.com/healthy-dinner-recipes/">dinner</a>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">I like to place fish tacos toppings with different textures in a large baking dish, cover with linen towel and set aside.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Chop toppings: </strong>Thinly slice or shred the cabbage or lettuce. Freshly shredded purple cabbage or green cabbage adds the best crunch but store bought coleslaw mix or broccoli slaw will work as well. Dice avocado, tomato, cilantro and red onion. Crumble cotija cheese or feta cheese.</p>



<div id="AdThrive_Content_7_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-7 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div><figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="800" height="530" src="https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/fish-tacos-recipe-3.jpg" alt="Shredded cabbage, diced tomatoes, avocado, red onion, lime and cilantro in a dish." class="wp-image-48418" srcset="https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/fish-tacos-recipe-3.jpg 800w, https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/fish-tacos-recipe-3-300x199.jpg 300w, https://ifoodreal.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/fish-tacos-recipe-3-768x509.jpg 768w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 800px) 100vw, 800px"></figure>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>To assemble tacos:</strong> Warm tortillas in a cast iron skillet on high heat for 10 seconds per side and press on them with spatula. It makes fish tacos extra delicious! Fill each tortilla with 3-4 pieces of fish, add toppings and drizzle with sauce.</p>



<div class="wp-block-group has-quinary-background-color has-background is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-tips-for-making-the-best-tacos">Tips for Best Results</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Here are my top tips for the best fish tacos I have been making for past 7 years!</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Skip non-fat yogurt:</strong> Do not use 0% yogurt for the fish taco sauce because it will lack flavor.</li>



<li><strong>Don’t overcook fish:</strong> Fish cooks fast, so don’t overcook it to avoid rubbery fish.</li>



<li><strong>Do not overcrowd the skillet:</strong> Leave room for air to flow between fish pieces to keep fish coating crunchy.</li>



<li><strong>Double the recipe for 4+ people:</strong> I highly recommend to double this fish taco recipe. Single recipe makes 9 tacos and I find we all want 3-4 tacos each. And nobody minds the leftovers.</li>
</ul>
</div>



<div id="AdThrive_Content_8_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-8 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div><h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-what-to-serve-this-with">What to Serve with Fish Tacos?</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">These fish tacos are quite filling meal, so you will not need many side dishes. Here are a few ideas:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Fruity salsas:</strong> Sweet with heat <a href="https://ifoodreal.com/mango-salsa-recipe/">mango salsa</a>, <a href="https://ifoodreal.com/pineapple-salsa/">pineapple jalapeno salsa</a> or <a href="https://ifoodreal.com/pico-de-gallo/">pico de gallo</a> round out flavors of any tacos very nicely.</li>



<li><a href="https://ifoodreal.com/easy-guacamole-recipe/">Guacamole</a></li>



<li>I recommend to make this super easy <a href="https://ifoodreal.com/instant-pot-corn/">Instant Pot corn on the cob</a>.</li>



<li><a href="https://ifoodreal.com/instant-pot-refried-beans/">Instant Pot refried beans</a></li>
</ul>



<div id="AdThrive_Content_9_desktop" class="adthrive-ad adthrive-content adthrive-content-9 adthrive-ad-cls" style="min-height: 250px;"></div><h2 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-faqs">FAQs</h2>



<div class="schema-faq wp-block-yoast-faq-block"><div class="schema-faq-section" id="faq-question-1649985383975"><strong class="schema-faq-question" style="cursor: pointer;">Can I make fish tacos in air fryer? <button aria-label="Display answer" class="schema-faq-toggle"></button></strong> <p class="schema-faq-answer">While I have not tested this, I am sure it will work! Air fry fish at 390 F for 12-15 minutes total, flipping after 8-10 minutes. Air fryer makes and models differ, so keep an eye on the fish.</p> </div> </div>
